shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile facing right
hair and beard rendered as regular rows of tight curls
almond profile eye with brow ridge
low-relief figure with detailed patterned surface texture (feathers / fleece rendered as repeated overlapping scale-like units)
figure accompanied by held or led attributes
justification: Both show a bearded male head in strict profile facing right, with hair and beard rendered in the same convention of dense regular rows of tight curls under a banded headdress, carved in shallow relief with heavily patterned surfaces (feathering in A, fleece in B) — a fairly specific shared repertoire of conventions. The subjects differ substantially, however: A depicts a winged supernatural figure raising a hand and holding a vessel, while B depicts an ordinary attendant leading two rams whose horned heads dominate the lower field, so the depicted scenes and relationships are not the same.
